args.message: Here's revenue (the sum of order amounts) for each city, with its region's total revenue on the same row. All orders are included, whatever their status. Orders with no known region or city are kept as null groups. One group is Paris, whose region is unknown. The other group, with both region and city null, mostly holds orders whose customer isn't in the customers table. The null-region row total is 1,193.30. Oslo shows up under both North and South because some Oslo customers are assigned to each region. All the rows add up to about 332,688.45, which matches total order revenue, so no orders were dropped.
